column1: # docs/prose-budget.tsv — byte ceilings on what a session or a Codex pass loads unasked (D-116).
# Read and enforced by scripts/check-prose-budget.sh (hermetic tier); the plan is docs/PROSE-BUDGET-PLAN.md.
# Columns, TAB-separated: key, ceiling_bytes, set (date and who), why.
# A key is a path, a section (path#<heading text>: that `## ` heading to the next), a frontmatter
# field (path:description), or a class total. The check, not this table, decides what must be here.
# Ceiling = landed size + 10%, rounded up to 4,096 (`sh scripts/check-prose-budget.sh --sizes`).
# RAISE only on the operator's word: edit the key's line, the date and the reason in `set`/`why`, in
# the commit that needs the room. A lane never raises one; it names the overage in READY.
# LOWER freely: a lane that trims a text lowers its line to the new formula value in the same commit.
